subject: Can't find where to share a folder
body: Hi! How do I share a folder with my sister so she can edit the files too? Thanks so much!

subject: Nobody on our team can sync
body: Since 9am none of our 240 users can sync. The desktop client just says 'Service unavailable'. This is blocking our whole company and we're extremely frustrated.

subject: Charged twice this month
body: I was billed $12 twice on March 3 for my Pro plan. Please refund the duplicate charge.

subject: Dark mode please
body: Would love a dark mode in the web app. Nimbus is great otherwise, thanks!

subject: Files disappeared after update
body: After updating the desktop app yesterday, about 300 files in my Projects folder are gone, and they're not in the trash either. I need them for a client deadline on Friday.

subject: Invoice has the wrong company name
body: Our March invoice lists 'Acme Corp' but our legal name is 'Acme Holdings LLC'. Can you reissue it?

subject: Locked out after changing phones
body: I got a new phone and now I can't log in because the 2FA codes go to my old one. This is really frustrating, I can't get into my account at all.

subject: Someone logged in from another country
body: I got an email that my account was accessed from Brazil. I've never been there. I think I've been hacked.

subject: View-only team folders
body: How do we set up shared team folders where most people only have view access?

subject: Wrong plan charge
body: You charged me $479 for an annual Business plan but I'm on monthly Pro. This is not okay.

subject: Great app, one idea
body: Love Nimbus, been using it for years. It would be amazing if you added a Linux desktop client.

subject: Internal link is public
body: We discovered that a shared link set to internal-only is accessible to anyone without logging in. Confidential HR files were exposed. This is unacceptable.

subject: Cancel subscription
body: Please cancel my Pro subscription at the end of this billing period.

subject: Large uploads fail
body: Uploads of videos over 2 GB fail at 99% with error E-413. Smaller files upload fine. Is there a size limit I'm missing?

subject: Add 25 seats
body: We're onboarding a new team next week. How do we add 25 more seats to our workspace?

subject: Sync is slow, and a question
body: Sync has been really slow for a week: uploads crawl at 50 KB/s on a 1 Gbps connection. This is getting really annoying. Also, is there a way to pause sync on metered networks?

subject: Oh great, another outage
body: Wow, love paying nothing and getting exactly that. Sync has been down for my whole team for 3 hours. Fantastic.

subject: Audit log export
body: Our compliance team needs to export audit logs to our SIEM. Is this on the roadmap?

subject: Refund for accidental annual plan
body: I switched to annual by mistake and was charged $96. Can I get a refund?

subject: Restore an older version
body: How do I restore a previous version of a document I edited last week?

subject: SSO login broken for everyone
body: Since this morning our Okta SSO login fails with 'invalid assertion' for every user. Nobody at the company can access Nimbus. This is a disaster.

subject: Talk to a human please
body: I've been going back and forth with the bot for an hour about a sync conflict that keeps duplicating my files. Can I please talk to a real person?

subject: Change my email
body: How can I change the email address on my account? I'm moving to a new job.

subject: Invoice overcharge
body: Our latest invoice is $3,200 higher than our contract rate. Please correct it and send a revised invoice.

subject: Longer version history
body: Is it possible to extend version history from 30 to 180 days on the Pro plan?

subject: Android app crashes
body: The Android app crashes immediately on launch since the last update. Reinstalling didn't help. Please fix it, I need my files on the go.
